d:
Bhagvan shiv ki bhakti aur mahima se paripurn in sundar shiv bhajnon ka aanand len. bholenath ki kripa, mahadev ki mahima aur unki asim shakti ka gungan karte ye madhur bhajan aapke man ko bhaktibhav aur sakaratmak oorja se bhar denge.
Abhijit ki surili aavaz men **'jay shiv shankar namami shankar'** aur lakhbir sinh lakkha ki bhaktimay aavaz men **'sare jag men viraje re mere shiv bhole'** jaise manmohak bhajnon ke sath bhagvan shiv ki aaradhna karen.
Jai Shiv Shankar Namami Shankar – Abhijeet 00:00
2. Saare Jag Mein Viraje Re Mere Shiv Bhole – Lakhbir Singh Lakkha 04:33
Music Label: T-Series
